name: element-merge-recipe
intent: Dual element inputs travel 104px into a central seam flash, then resolve as a dual-tone result token.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Result token appears directly; no travel or seam flash

acceptance: Two orbs travel travelPx 104 from opposite sides in travelMs 340 into the centre slot
Merge phase shows a vertical seam flash (seamWPx 3 × seamHPx 44) for mergeMs 200 before inputs vanish
Result token is dual-tone conic (chakra|danger halves) after settleMs 160
Replay resets both inputs and clears the result before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows the result immediately with animations disabled
